verdicts.rationale: The checker strips packages and accepts the same simple class name from another package; method names are also unconstrained.
A promoted row currently passes with no commands and no regression-tests gate.
Path normalization makes dot and repeated-separator spellings resolve to the same file while raw-string uniqueness accepts them.
Empty and duplicate candidate IDs and empty source contract IDs currently pass, and sealed candidate-status.csv is not consulted.
